FORM 8-K

VOLUNTARY DISCLOSURE FILER, INC.

Item 8.01 Other Events.

On April 23, 2026, Voluntary Disclosure Filer, Inc. is providing a voluntary update regarding a previously identified cybersecurity incident. The Company has confirmed unauthorized access to a portion of its development environment.

The Company has not yet determined whether the incident is reasonably likely to result in a material impact on its results of operations and is continuing to assess scope.
